response.original_title: Silversea Cruises Complaint Guide: How to Escalate Your Issue
response.overview: You can escalate a customer service issue or complaint with Silversea Cruises by calling their primary general customer service line at +1-866-254-7549 or the Americas office at +1-866-254-7549, or by emailing GuestExperience@silversea.com. How to Escalate an Issue Onboard the Ship: Speak directly with the Guest Services desk (+1-866-254-7549) or your suite steward/butler, and ask to speak with the Guest Services Manager or Hotel Director if the frontline staff cannot resolve the matter. Post-Cruise or General Support: Call customer service +1-866-254-7549 and politely request to be transferred to a supervisor +1-866-254-7549, tier-two agent, or the escalation/customer relations team.
